753:t_034:4.en:
$n
「Now that $$アドヴェント#pilot$$'s power is gone, I should be able to do it...!」

753:t_034:5.en:
$n
「I'll take over $$至高神Ｚ$$ with the $$いがみ合う双子$$!」

753:t_034:6.en:
$$トライア$$
「That's reckless! If you do that, you'll have to bear every soul of $$エス・テラン$$ all by yourself!」

753:t_034:7.en:
$n
「$$桂$$, $$オルソン$$, $$ツィーネ$$! The $$黒い太陽#sol$$... the $$超特異点$$ has to be inside this thing!」

753:t_034:8.en:
$n
「Please! Save the universe with a $$時空修復|lc$$!」

753:t_034:10.en:
$n
「Every living thing in the universe must want to live! It will surely succeed!」

753:t_034:12.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「If you, who aren't even a higher-dimensional life form, do such a thing, your existence will be completely absorbed into the flow of $$オリジン・ロー$$ and vanish beyond the causal horizon!」

753:t_034:13.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You'll be cast completely out of the natural order, and you'll never be able to reincarnate again!!」

753:t_034:15.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You're not... afraid of vanishing...?」

753:t_034:16.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「So this is... what it means to stake your life...」

753:t_035:1.en:
$n
「Someone pick up Miss $$スズネ$$, I'm counting on you!」

753:t_035:3.en:
$n
「I'm only giving back the life everyone saved for me.」

753:t_035:4.en:
$$アルト$$
「You idiot! Who asked you to do that!」

753:t_035:6.en:
$n
「$$キタン$$ and $$ゼロ$$ staked their lives! So can I...!」

753:t_036:1.en:
$n
「Someone pick up Miss $$スズネ$$, I'm counting on you!」

753:t_036:3.en:
$n
「I'm only giving back the life everyone saved for me.」

753:t_036:4.en:
$$アルト$$
「You idiot! Who asked you to do that!」

753:t_036:6.en:
$n
「$$キタン$$, Major $$グラハム$$, and $$ゼロ$$ all staked their lives! So can I...!」

753:t_037:1.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Did you forget? I can teleport over short distances.」

753:t_037:2.en:
$n
「Why did you come back!? This way, I...」

753:t_037:3.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You're the one getting out of here, $n!」

753:t_037:5.en:
$$スズネ$$
「There are two conflicting personalities inside me! I'm sure even I can take over the Supreme God with the power of the $$いがみ合う双子$$!」

753:t_037:6.en:
$n
「But that defeats the purpose! I wanted to save Miss $$スズネ$$...!」

753:t_037:7.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Do you think I can stand by in silence when someone I love says they'll die right in front of me!」

753:t_037:9.en:
$$シモン$$
「I can't watch this! A lovers' quarrel with the great collapse of the universe right in front of us!」

753:t_038:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「If you think you're the only $$いがみ合う双子$$ reactor, you're dead wrong, $n!」

753:t_038:3.en:
$$シン$$
「You're not the only one who has fought on by overcoming conflicting emotions!」

753:t_038:4.en:
$$タケル$$
「I told you back when we fought the evil gods! That all of us are here because we overcame hope and despair!」

753:t_038:5.en:
$$キラ$$
「So all of us will use the power of the $$いがみ合う双子$$!」

753:t_038:7.en:
$n
「...I'm sure it can be done... Because the $$いがみ合う双子$$ $$スフィア$$ is humanity itself.」

753:t_038:9.en:
$n
「The twelve $$スフィア$$s are the many emotions of humanity... The $$太極$$, their collective that holds a will, is humanity itself, living with its contradictions.」

753:t_038:10.en:
$n
「The $$いがみ合う双子$$ is like a miniature of that $$太極$$... That's why I think it will become the core of the twelve $$スフィア$$s.」

753:t_038:11.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Chief, AG! Use the $$Ｚクリスタル$$ to connect our minds to $n!」

753:t_038:12.en:
$$セツコ$$
「All of us together will hold $$至高神Ｚ$$ down!」

753:t_038:13.en:
$$ランド$$
「While we're at it! We'll gather the feelings of everyone in the universe who wants to live, and do the $$時空修復|lc$$ too!」

753:t_038:15.en:
$$桂$$
「OK! $$オルソン$$ and $$ツィーネ$$ are good to go too, right!」

753:t_038:17.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「Everything that began with the $$大時空震動$$ ends here!」

753:t_038:18.en:
$$アムロ$$
「You can pull this off, right, AG!」

753:t_038:19.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'll show you! Even if the $$Ｚクリスタル$$ shatters!」

753:t_038:21.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「It's too early to show a smile.」

753:t_038:22.en:
$$万丈$$
「It's the repair of every world born from the $$大時空震動$$. We can't know what will happen.」

753:t_038:24.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Yeah! I absolutely don't want the universe to end!」

753:t_038:25.en:
$$正太郎$$
「I'm sure everyone feels the same way!」

753:t_038:26.en:
$$アポロ$$
「We'll take on all their feelings!」

753:t_038:27.en:
$$アマタ$$
「We're doing this together! For the people we love and the world we have to protect!」

753:t_038:28.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Let's go! The biggest stage in the universe begins now!」

753:t_038:29.en:
$$シンジ$$
「For the future of every world!」

753:t_038:30.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I'll make a miracle happen now!」

753:t_038:31.en:
$$シャア$$
「$n! I'll match my timing to yours!」
